newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Steel Semicon to make 64MB DRAMS - paper.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Steel Semicon to make 64MB DRAMS - paper.

text.p: Nippon Steel Semiconductor Corp will start commercial production of 64 megabit dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips in the second half of 1998, a Japanese newspaper said.
The value of the investment necessary for the planned 64 megabit DRAM production is expected to be 10 billion to 15 billion yen, the economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
Nippon Steel Semiconductor officials were not immediately available for comment.
Nippon Steel Semiconductor is partly owned by a unit of Nippon Steel Corp.
